title: OpenAI banned US-origin account using AI for fake troll error message
summary: OpenAI banned an account likely originating in the US that used AI to create a fake ChatGPT error message claiming to detect 'Russian troll' activity, identified as Hoax: Fake Russian 'troll' error message.
why_included: This highlights the use of AI for disinformation and deception, specifically creating fake error messages to mislead users, and OpenAI's banning of such accounts.

title: OpenAI banned Iran-linked cyber operations using AI
summary: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to belong to CyberAv3ngers, using AI to research industrial control systems, default credentials, and targets.
why_included: This reveals the use of AI in cyber warfare research and targeting critical infrastructure by Iranian actors, and OpenAI's enforcement actions.

title: OpenAI banned China-linked cyber activity using AI
summary: OpenAI banned accounts likely belonging to a suspected China-based adversary tracked as SweetSpecter, using AI to research vulnerabilities, write code, and support spear-phishing activity.
why_included: This details AI's application in cyber operations by Chinese actors for vulnerability research and spear-phishing, and OpenAI's actions to counter these threats.

title: OpenAI banned Iran-linked malware and scraping activity using AI
summary: OpenAI banned Iran-linked STORM-0817 accounts using AI to debug Android malware, scrape social platforms, and translate tooling.
why_included: This highlights AI's use in developing and deploying malware and scraping tools by Iranian actors, and OpenAI's enforcement actions.
